external.note: Host Python 3.9+ runs every script; run it with -I when it reads downloaded reference files.
All metrics; Blender bundles its own numpy for tl_blender.py.

tests/: synthetic tests run anywhere; test_blender.py skips without Blender; test_references.py skips unless CTA_LIBRARY_ROOT / CTA_MPFB_DATA (and CTA_VERIFIER_DATA, CTA_GAME_PROFILE, CTA_OWN_G1) name the inputs.

Background only (-b --factory-startup --disable-autoexec --python-exit-code 2) runs tl_blender.py: appending objects from a .blend (never opened whole), importing other formats, Tris to Quads with normals computed, the Decimate / QuadriFlow control generator. Found through blender-organic-modeling/scripts/blender_env.py. Numbers in the references were measured on Blender 5.1.2. OBJ, GLB and NPZ need no Blender.

The accepted reference library (read only, never copied) and the MPFB2 data folder holding the CC0 hm08 base mesh; paths given per call (--root library_root=..., --root mpfb=...) or by CTA_LIBRARY_ROOT / CTA_MPFB_DATA for the tests.

A game profile (copy of profiles/template_game.json filled by profile_from_survey.py from the game's shipped units) kept in the consuming game's layer; without it budgets and shares are reported, not gated.
Consumer-provided phase-handoff contract, not bundled. In this library it is hosted by blender-architecture-texturing (references/handoff-contract.md, scripts/handoff.py).
